task_instance: For a text-heavy developer documentation site (system fonts, light mode, fluid type), produce the skill's core deliverable: a production-ready typography.css of CSS custom properties (type scale, line heights, tracking, weights, measure, spacing tokens, layout proportions, colors) plus base styles and a flow utility, as generated by the bundled generator with ratio minor-third, fonts system, spacing 8px-grid, color-mode light, fluid.
blocker_detail: The skill's central deliverable is generated by executing its bundled Python generator script (invoked in steps 2 and 5 of the workflow with ratio/font/spacing/color/fluid flags). The office-assistant runtime cannot run code or any script, so the script cannot be executed. The script file itself is present next to SKILL.md (so it is not a missing skill file), but the runtime lacks the ability to run it, and per the run rules I must not hand-write, stub, or mock a replacement for the bundled script nor fabricate its CSS/JSON output. Reading and writing text could in principle reproduce the modular-scale math by hand, but doing so would be exactly the forbidden replacement of the specified bundled script.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: workflow steps 2 and 5 require running the bundled generator script to produce the type-scale JSON and the complete CSS custom-properties block (the actual deliverable). Confirmed via Glob that the skill bundle contains the generator script, a references typography guide, and SKILL.md under skills/type-craft/ (so bundled files are present, not missing). Read the generator script: a ~580-line argparse Python program whose only output paths are print(format_css(...)) / print(format_json(...)); producing the deliverable requires executing it. The runtime grants only text read/write/edit and web fetch/search (no shell, no code execution), so the script cannot be run. Created sample user input at project_brief.md in the work directory (legitimate input a user would supply). No deliverable CSS could be produced or verified because generating it requires executing the bundled script, which this runtime cannot do.
